lighting.setup: skylight shaft plus one narrow cold spotlight on the sculpture
lighting.environment: brutalist board-formed concrete hall, wet polished concrete floor, thin volumetric haze

rationale: Black chrome needs a structured environment to read as metal: the concrete hall and skylight give it something to reflect. Titanium and tarnished silver add two lower-gloss steps so the arm does not read as plastic. 7500 K keeps the light cold but near-neutral, so the red joint stays the only saturated color.
plausibility_notes: black chrome: high specular reflectance with low albedo, so its highlights are cold white, not grey
glass and acrylic are not metals; they are specified in the subject text (schema covers metals only)
